kjv: Which was the son of Aminadab, which was the son of Aram
mine: the son of Amminadab, the son of Admin, the son of Arni
note: TR assimilates to Matt 1:3-4 and Ruth 4:19 ("Aram"); the earliest manuscripts have the otherwise unknown names Admin and Arni (with many variants).

kjv: Which was the son of Jose
note: TR "Iose" against "Iesou" (Joshua/Jesus) in Sinaiticus, Vaticanus, L; KJV elsewhere renders Iesous as "Jesus" even for Joshua (Acts 7:45, Heb 4:8).
